title: Wall Street Analysts Predict 70% Upside for This AI Memory Stock in 2027
excerpt: Micron stock trades near $911 with a $1,569 average target, about 70% upside, as 2027 memory tightens. But one chart level flashes a warning.
content_html:
Micron (MU) stock is holding near $911 after a 189% price rise in 2026. Yet, Wall Street still sees roughly 70% more upside. And there is good reason behind this optimism. The world is short of the memory that powers AI, and Micron seems very well positioned to fix that problem.

Still, the stock has already priced in a lot. So the real test is whether demand and new long-term contracts can keep earnings high, and one chart level could decide the next price leg.

What Does Wall Street's 70% Upside Mean?

It means strong agreement on direction. Across 30 analysts tracked by TipRanks, Micron is a Strong Buy, with 29 Buy ratings and no Sells. The average target near $1,569 sits about 70% above today's price.

However, that 70% is an average, not a promise. Targets run from $1,100 all the way to $2,200, so the real argument is about how long the good times last. To see who is right, start with the rally itself.

Why Has Micron Stock Jumped 189% This Year?

Because its results have exploded. Micron reported quarterly revenue of $41.46 billion, up from $9.30 billion a year earlier, with DRAM revenue up 343%.

The cause is AI. Every AI server needs more high-bandwidth memory, and making it eats up capacity that would otherwise build regular memory.

Less supply lifts prices, and higher prices lift Micron's profits. That run pushed Micron past $1 trillion, though the stock now sits about 14% below its July high.

Can Micron's Memory Boom Last Into 2027?

For now, the answer leans yes. Micron says memory should stay tight beyond 2027, and industry reports on the memory crunch say suppliers have already booked much of their 2027 output.

New factories take years to build, so supply cannot catch up quickly.

Micron is also changing how it sells. It signed 16 multi-year customer deals covering about 20% of its DRAM and a third of its NAND.

As a result, more revenue is locked in, which could soften the memory industry's usual boom-and-bust swings.

Note: Micron's business has always been boom-and-bust. Prices spike when memory is scarce, then crash when supply floods back, so its profits swing wildly and investors pay a low multiple for those unreliable earnings. Locking ~20% of DRAM and a third of NAND into 5-year contracts means a big chunk of revenue is now guaranteed in advance, no matter what spot prices do. That makes earnings steadier.

Why are Analysts Divided on Micron?

Because they disagree on how long the boom lasts. Melius sees $2,200, while Citi cut its target to $1,150 on August 10, warning that margins may fade.

content_html_zh:
美光 (MU) 股价在 2026 年上涨 189% 后目前维持在 911 美元附近。 然而，华尔街仍认为还有大约 70% 的上涨空间。 这种乐观背后有充分的理由。 世界缺乏为人工智能提供动力的内存，而美光似乎非常有能力解决这个问题。

尽管如此，该股的定价已经很高了。 因此，真正的考验是需求和新的长期合同能否保持高收益，而一个图表水平可以决定下一个价格走势。

华尔街70%的上涨意味着什么？

这意味着方向上的强烈一致。 在 TipRanks 跟踪的 30 名分析师中，美光科技的评级为“强力买入”，其中 29 名分析师给出“买入”评级，没有人给出“卖出”评级。 平均目标价接近 1,569 美元，较今日价格高出约 70%。

然而，70%只是一个平均值，而不是一个承诺。 目标从 1,100 美元一直到 2,200 美元，所以真正的争论是美好时光能持续多久。 要看看谁是对的，就从集会本身开始吧。

为什么美光今年股价暴涨 189%？

因为它的成果已经爆炸了。 美光公布季度营收 414.6 亿美元，高于去年同期的 93 亿美元，其中 DRAM 营收增长 343%。

原因是人工智能。 每个人工智能服务器都需要更多的高带宽内存，这会占用原本可以构建常规内存的容量。

供应减少会抬高价格，而价格上涨会提高美光的利润。 此次上涨使美光科技的股价突破了 1 万亿美元，但该股目前仍较 7 月高点低约 14%。

美光的内存热潮能否持续到 2027 年？

目前来看，答案是肯定的。 美光表示，2027 年之后内存将继续紧张，有关内存紧缩的行业报告称，供应商已经预订了 2027 年的大部分产量。

新工厂需要数年时间才能建成，因此供应无法迅速跟上。

美光科技也在改变其销售方式。 该公司签署了 16 项多年期客户协议，涵盖约 20% 的 DRAM 和三分之一的 NAND。

因此，更多的收入被锁定，这可能会缓解内存行业通常的繁荣和萧条波动。

注：美光科技的业务一直是兴衰交替的。 当内存稀缺时，价格会飙升，而当供应大量增加时，价格就会暴跌，因此其利润大幅波动，投资者为那些不可靠的收益支付较低的市盈率。 将约 20% 的 DRAM 和三分之一的 NAND 锁定在 5 年期合同中，意味着无论现货价格如何变化，现在都会提前保证很大一部分收入。 这使得收益更加稳定。

分析师为何对美光存在分歧？

因为他们对于繁荣持续多久存在分歧。 Melius 预计目标价为 2,200 美元，而花旗则在 8 月 10 日将目标价下调至 1,150 美元，警告利润率可能会下降。
